logline: One impossible dream structure built from the ground up and paid off in a single reveal.

shot_plan: CAMERA A — CHAIN BREAK: Start a fresh exterior scene in a LOCKED-OFF TRIPOD wide shot; keep the exact camera position and angle, allowing only a slow zoom. Begin on an empty site, grade the ground, and establish the road, fence, and landscape framework before construction; materials and the recurring silent USTA enter, seen from behind or mid-distance in a dark cap, dark crew-neck, and work gloves, never in face close-up. Mark the foundation so the structure's location is unmistakable.

CAMERA A — CHAINED: Continue from shot 1's final frame in the same LOCKED-OFF TRIPOD position and angle, allowing only a slow zoom. Raise the foundation, walls, and roof frame in this same composition with accelerating timelapse energy and satisfying material flow. Keep the same recurring silent USTA in a dark cap, dark crew-neck, and work gloves, seen from behind or mid-distance, never in face close-up.

CAMERA A — CHAINED: Continue from shot 2's final frame in the exact same LOCKED-OFF TRIPOD position and angle, allowing only a slow zoom. Complete the cladding, roof, paint, exterior lights, and final landscaping until the exterior is entirely finished and remains clearly visible in frame. Keep the same recurring silent USTA in a dark cap, dark crew-neck, and work gloves, seen from behind or mid-distance, never in face close-up.

CAMERA B — CHAIN BREAK: Start a fresh interior wide scene with a LOCKED-OFF TRIPOD; keep this exact interior camera position and angle, allowing only a slow zoom. Build the interior walls, lay the flooring, and install the utility and lighting infrastructure while carrying the exterior's established materials and design language inside. Keep the same recurring silent USTA in a dark cap, dark crew-neck, and work gloves, seen from behind or mid-distance, never in face close-up.

CAMERA B — CHAINED: Continue from shot 4's final frame in the exact same LOCKED-OFF TRIPOD position and angle, allowing only a slow zoom. Install furniture and decor, bring the lighting on, and finish the interior completely until it feels ready to inhabit. Keep the same recurring silent USTA in a dark cap, dark crew-neck, and work gloves, seen from behind or mid-distance, never in face close-up.

REVEAL TOUR — CHAINED FROM CAMERA B: Continue directly from shot 5's final frame; this is the only exception to the LOCKED-OFF TRIPOD rule. Make one unbroken camera move that starts inside, flows through a door or window, and ends on a wide exterior view of the fully finished structure, delivering the single interior-and-exterior payoff. The same silent USTA may remain in a dark cap, dark crew-neck, and work gloves, seen from behind or mid-distance, but never celebrates, looks at camera, poses 'ta-da,' speaks, or appears in face close-up. This is hook shot 6.
auto_replenish.music_style: Steady-tempo percussive construction music synchronized to the build rhythm; soften for one beat at the end of shot 5, open up through the shot 6 reveal tour, and finish gently. No epic trailer bombast, no ethereal intro, and no vocals.
auto_replenish.title_style: a punchy English YouTube Shorts title using ONE of these FIVE patterns only, never invent a new one: (1) 'Building A <X> From Scratch! 🛠️✨', (2) 'Building A <FRANCHISE> <STRUCTURE> From SCRATCH! 🛠️✨' with the franchise name in CAPS, (3) '<Before> → <Stunning After> ✨' only for the transformation family, (4) 'He Turned <X> Into A $<N> <Y>! ♻️✨' only for the transformation or recycling/off-grid transformation families, (5) 'Building A $<N> <X> From Scratch! ✨'. HARD MAXIMUM: 60 characters total, including spaces and emoji. Keep value-hook titles compact by shortening <X> or <Y>, never by dropping $<N>. One or two emoji are required. No hashtags or surrounding quotes.
auto_replenish.brief: FROM SCRATCH üretim brief'i (dayanak: aimagine/KONSEPT.md v2.0, 2026-08-04). >>> ÇIKTI DİLİ İNGİLİZCE <<< Bu brief Türkçedir ama bölüm başlığı, synopsis, tüm çekim prompt'ları ve müzik tarifi İngilizce yazılır. DEĞİŞMEZ KURALLAR: (1) İMZA FORMAT: Tek yapı, altı çekim ve yaklaşık 60 saniye. Çekim 1 boş arsada çevre ve zeminle başlar; çekim 2 gövdeyi yükseltir; çekim 3 dışı tamamen bitirir; çekim 4 bağımsız iç zinciri kurar; çekim 5 içi tamamen döşer; çekim 6 içeriden dış geniş finale akan tek kesintisiz reveal turudur ve hook_shot her zaman 6'dır. (2) SABİT KARE + ZİNCİR: Kamera-A çekim 1-3'te, Kamera-B çekim 4-5'te tripod kilidindedir; yalnız yavaş zoom serbesttir. Çekim 1 ve 4 yeni sahne açar, diğer çekimler önceki son kareden zincirlenir. Bölümler arasında zincir yoktur. (3) USTA: Aynı sessiz usta koyu bere/şapka, koyu üst ve iş eldivenleriyle arkadan, yandan veya orta mesafeden görünür; yüz yakın planı, konuşma ve kameraya bakış yoktur. (4) AİLE ROTASYONU: family yalnız altı kanonik aileden biri olur ve aynı aile art arda kullanılamaz. Bölüm başına tek yapı ve tek reveal vardır; iç mekan aynı yapının içidir. Doktrin §6 yalnız ilham konularıdır; seed_id ve topic_pool yoktur. Başlık her zaman beş title_style kalıbından üretilir ve aile kısıtına uyar. Başlık boşluklar ve emojiler dahil en fazla 60 karakterdir; değer kancasını korumak için <X>/<Y>'yi kısalt, $<N>'yi atma. (5) SES: Narration ve voiceover yoktur; tek ses inşaat ritmine senkron sabit tempolu perküsif müziktir. Çekim 5 sonunda tek vuruş yumuşar, çekim 6'da açılır ve yumuşak kapanır; loop dikişi yoktur. (6) YORUM YEMİ: Bölüm başına en fazla bir yarım-soru; rage-bait yasaktır. (7) YASAKLAR: Kutlama, ta-da, kameraya bakış, kapanış kartı, okunur yazı, logo ve watermark yoktur. Korumasız elektrik işi, güvenliksiz derin kazı, açık alev ve başka tehlikeli pratikler özendirilmez.
